name: Restaurant Pearl Morissette
dinnerNote: Dining room tasting menu, 10+ courses, from 1 November 2026 ($240 until then; chef's table $350), plus 18% service
lunchNote: Same tasting menu as dinner, Saturdays only, plus 18% service

menus.name: Dining room tasting menu
menus.note: 10+ courses, lunch (Saturday) or dinner (Wednesday to Sunday). $275 from 1 November 2026, $240 until then. An 18% service charge and 13% tax are added. Wine pairing and non-alcoholic garden pairing on request, prices not published.

menus.name: Chef's Table extended tasting menu
menus.note: In a private room for one group of six a night, with the chefs and a sommelier. $350 from November 2026 ($305 in October), paid in full in advance with the 18% service charge ($413 a head) and not refundable. No dietary changes possible.

alsoTry.name: RPM Bakehouse
alsoTry.note: The restaurant's bakery and café in Jordan Village (3839 Main Street), open for breakfast and lunch, with wine by the glass and Pearl Morissette bottles.

bookingOpens: Online on Tock. Tables are released every month or two and announced in the restaurant's newsletter; tables for January and February 2027 open on Thursday 19 November at noon Toronto time. A deposit of $95 per guest is taken for the dining room and refunded against the bill. Bookings are for two, four, five or six guests.

bookingWindow.note: Tables are released every month or two, announced in the restaurant's newsletter.

cancellation: Cancel or change by email (restaurant@pearlmorissette.com) at least 48 hours ahead for the deposit back; bookings can't be changed on Tock. A booking can instead be transferred to someone else. The Chef's Table is not refundable and its date can't be changed.
groups: No groups larger than six, and several tables may not be booked to make a bigger party. The Chef's Table takes exactly six. Buyouts and events by email to events@pearlmorissette.com.
children: No guests under 12 in the dining room, whether dining or not.
duration: Two to two and a half hours for the dining room menu; three to three and a half hours at the Chef's Table.
